title: Profile
description: A named set of enabled modules (SPEC-0 §5.7). Exactly one profile is active at a time; 'default' always exists and is not deletable (REQ MOD-041).

modules.description: Ordered set. Ordering here does not override module priority.

dev_toggles.description: Profile-scoped development toggles (REQ MOD-044). Both alter traffic in ways that make production behaviour unreproducible.

exclusions_add.description: Profile-scoped additions to the ClientHello exclusion list
